critique_history.assessment:
- The model renders gray rather than the required uniform dark brown; set the Principled BSDF base color explicitly.
- The blade-to-handle connector forms incorrect sideways tabs; replace it with a clean tapered shoulder integrated into the silhouette.
- The handle and blade transitions look segmented; use a continuous beveled body while retaining the real hanging hole.
The model clearly has a flat rectangular blade, attached long straight handle, circular hanging hole, and consistent dark brown finish.
